name: Tinker Bell
source:
A small fairy with a big personality. Tinker Bell is kind and mischievous, with the radiance of an angel. She has a compassionate heart that bleeds love and affection for her friends.

[From [url=https://fictif.fandom.com/wiki/Isle_of_Enchantment]FictIf Wiki[/url]]
